simple.prompt: The new fiber-optic network is significantly ___ than our previous broadband connection.
simple.explanation: Adjective 1 suku kata (fast) membentuk comparative dengan menambahkan akhiran -er: 'faster than'.

simple.prompt: This cloud migration strategy is ___ than the alternative proposed by the consultant.
simple.explanation: Adjective dengan 3 suku kata atau lebih (ex-pen-sive) menggunakan kata bantu 'more': 'more expensive than'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat perbandingan komparatif dengan kata hubung 'than'.
simple.explanation: Large berakhiran -e ditambah -r (larger) + than + noun pembanding (Singapore).

simple.prompt: Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
simple.explanation: Bentuk superlative dari adjective 1 suku kata 'high' adalah 'the highest' (wajib didahului 'the').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat superlative dengan adjective panjang.
simple.targetSentence: This is the most important decision.
simple.explanation: Superlative kata sifat panjang: 'the most important' + noun (decision).

simple.prompt: Her presentation was good, but her colleague's performance was even ___.
simple.explanation: 'Good' memiliki bentuk komparatif tidak beraturan (irregular comparative): good $\rightarrow$ better $\rightarrow$ the best.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat perbandingan kesetaraan dengan 'as ... as'.
simple.targetSentence: This model is as efficient as that one.
simple.explanation: Pola perbandingan setara: as + adjective dasar (efficient) + as + pembanding.
hints: Gunakan pola 'as efficient as that one'.

simple.prompt: This new fiber-optic connection is much ___ than our old DSL line.
simple.explanation: Kata sifat satu suku kata 'fast' membentuk comparative dengan akhiran -er ('faster'), bukan 'more fast'.

simple.prompt: Among all three hotels near the harbor, the Bayview Inn is the ___.
simple.explanation: Karena membandingkan tiga hotel dengan penanda 'the', gunakan bentuk superlative: 'quietest'.
hints: Jumlah yang dibandingkan ada tiga (lebih dari dua).

simple.prompt: Reading a concise checklist is ___ helpful than skimming a fifty-page manual.
simple.explanation: Adjective dua atau lebih suku kata berakhiran -ful ('helpful') membentuk comparative dengan 'more', bukan '-er'.

simple.prompt: Fortunately, our quarterly shipping costs were ___ this year than last year.
simple.explanation: 'Good' adalah adjective tidak beraturan: comparative-nya 'better', superlative-nya 'best'.
hints: Ingat bentuk tak beraturan 'good - better - best'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan membandingkan dua rute perjalanan.
dialogue: Driver
Should we take the ring road or the city avenue?
Navigator
The ring road is ___ right now, though it is two kilometers longer.
simple.explanation: Membandingkan dua rute ('ring road' vs 'city avenue') memakai comparative: 'less crowded'.
hints: Hanya ada dua pilihan jalan yang dibandingkan.
Superlative 'least' digunakan untuk tiga atau lebih.

simple.prompt: My new carry-on suitcase is just as ___ as yours, yet it weighs half as much.
simple.explanation: Dalam pola kesetaraan 'as + adjective + as', selalu gunakan adjective bentuk dasar tanpa '-er' atau 'more'.
hints: Sisipkan adjective murni di antara 'as' dan 'as'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda comparative pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: This ergonomic office chair feels more softer than the old wooden one.
options: This ergonomic office chair feels softer than the old wooden one.
This ergonomic office chair feels softest than the old wooden one.
This ergonomic office chair feels more soft than the old wooden one.
simple.explanation: Jangan pernah menggabungkan 'more' dan akhiran '-er' bersamaan ('more softer' salah); gunakan 'softer' saja.

simple.prompt: The humidity today feels ___ than yesterday's weather.
simple.explanation: Bentuk comparative tidak beraturan dari 'bad' adalah 'worse' (superlative: 'worst').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat comparative untuk kata sifat berakhiran -y.
simple.targetSentence: The revised user guide is much easier to follow than the first draft.
simple.explanation: 'Easy' berakhiran konsonan + y sehingga menjadi 'easier'; 'much' memperkuat tingkat comparative.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The revised user guide is'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kesetaraan dengan struktur 'not as ... as'.
simple.targetSentence: The afternoon train is not as crowded as the morning express.
simple.explanation: Struktur 'not as + adj + as' menyatakan satu hal tidak sama tingkatnya dengan hal lain.

dialogue: Manager
How do our Q3 sales figures compare to last year?
Analyst
Unfortunately, our revenue was ___ than we originally projected.
intermediate.explanation: 'Bad' memiliki bentuk komparatif irregular: bad $\rightarrow$ worse $\rightarrow$ the worst.

intermediate.prompt: For adjective berakhiran -y (seperti easy, heavy, friendly), bentuk komparatifnya adalah...
intermediate.explanation: Adjective 2 suku kata yang berakhiran -y mengubah 'y' menjadi 'i' lalu ditambah -er: easier, heavier, friendlier.

intermediate.prompt: The new smartphone interface is not nearly as ___ as the desktop dashboard.
intermediate.explanation: Di antara konstruksi 'as ... as' (atau 'not as ... as'), kata sifat WAJIB dalam bentuk positif dasar (positive degree), bukan komparatif: 'not as intuitive as'.
hints: Di antara 'as ... as' selalu gunakan bentuk dasar kata sifat.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penguat komparatif menggunakan kata 'much'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The upgraded software is much faster now.
intermediate.explanation: Adverb seperti 'much', 'far', atau 'significantly' dapat memperkuat komparatif: 'much faster'.

intermediate.prompt: We need to analyze the data ___ before reaching a binding agreement.
intermediate.explanation: 'Further' digunakan untuk makna kiasan/abstrak (tingkat lebih lanjut atau tambahan kedalaman). 'Farther' khusus untuk jarak fisik terukur.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat superlative yang dibatasi dengan frasa 'one of the'.
intermediate.targetSentence: This is one of the oldest universities in Europe.
intermediate.explanation: Pola: one of the + superlative adjective (oldest) + plural noun (universities) + prepositional phrase.
hints: Mulai dengan 'This is one of the oldest'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih modifier perbandingan halus yang tepat dalam dialog.
dialogue: Designer
Is the revised logo color acceptable?
Director
Yes, it is ___ darker than the original, which gives it better contrast.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menyatakan selisih kecil pada komparatif, gunakan modifier 'slightly', 'a bit', atau 'a little' sebelum kata komparatif: 'slightly darker'. (Jangan gunakan 'very' sebelum comparative).

intermediate.prompt: Today's prototype runs ___ faster after our developer removed the heavy background scripts.
intermediate.explanation: Modifier penguat comparative memakai kata seperti 'much', 'far', 'significantly', atau 'a lot' — BUKAN 'very' atau 'more'.
hints: Lihat kata 'faster' yang sudah berbentuk comparative.

intermediate.prompt: Because Jakarta traffic peaks at dusk, the airport express train is ___ the most convenient option.
intermediate.explanation: Superlative ('the most convenient') paling kuat ditekankan dengan frasa penguat superlative 'by far' atau 'easily'.
hints: 'By far' adalah penguat baku untuk superlative.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang rapat untuk membandingkan DUA pilihan secara tepat.
dialogue: Lead
Both finalists wrote strong proposals. Who should take the contract?
Director
Between the two agencies, Vertex submitted the ___ detailed budget.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam tata bahasa tulis baku, saat membandingkan TEPAT DUA hal ('Between the two agencies'), gunakan bentuk comparative ('the more detailed'), bukan superlative ('most').
hints: Tepat dua item memakai bentuk comparative.

intermediate.prompt: The further north our expedition sailed, the ___ the coastal winds became.
intermediate.explanation: Pola double comparative korelatif: 'The + comparative..., the + comparative...' ('The further..., the colder...').

intermediate.prompt: Please adjust the lighting slightly; the screen looks a bit ___ dim for comfortable reading.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menyatakan melebihi batas nyaman sebelum adjective dasar ('dim'), gunakan adverb 'too'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan objek pembanding yang tidak setara (faulty comparison) berikut.
intermediate.draft: The battery life of the Pro tablet lasts longer than the basic model's screen.
options: The battery life of the Pro tablet lasts longer than that of the basic model.
The battery life of the Pro tablet lasts longer than the basic model.
The battery life of the Pro tablet lasts more long than the basic model.
intermediate.explanation: Kita harus membandingkan hal yang setara: masa pakai baterai ('battery life') vs masa pakai baterai ('that of the basic model'), bukan membandingkan baterai dengan layar.
hints: Pastikan kedua sisi yang dibandingkan merupakan jenis hal yang sama.
Gunakan pronoun 'that of...' untuk merujuk kembali ke 'the battery life'.

intermediate.prompt: Winter temperatures in Munich dropped ___ lower this December than our climatologists predicted.
intermediate.explanation: 'Far' (seperti 'much' dan 'even') lazim dipakai untuk memperkuat comparative 'lower'; 'very' dan 'so' hanya untuk adjective dasar.

intermediate.prompt: Each sprint gets slightly smoother; overall, our release process is becoming ___.
intermediate.explanation: Progressive comparison untuk kata satu suku kata diulang dengan '-er and -er' ('faster and faster').
hints: Menggambarkan perubahan yang terus meningkat seiring waktu.

intermediate.targetSentence: The earlier we ship the samples, the sooner the client replies.
intermediate.explanation: 'The + comparative..., the + comparative...' menghubungkan dua perubahan yang sebanding.
hints: Awali dengan 'The earlier we ship the samples,'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'the sooner the client replies'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat perbandingan dengan penguat 'slightly' dan irregular comparative.
intermediate.targetSentence: Her revised slide deck is slightly better organized than last week's.
intermediate.explanation: Adverb tingkat kecil ('slightly', 'a little') dapat memodifikasi 'better'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Her revised slide deck is'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum 'double comparative' pada naskah editorial ini.
complex.draft: The automated deployment pipeline is more easier to maintain than legacy scripts.
options: The automated deployment pipeline is easier to maintain than legacy scripts.
The automated deployment pipeline is much easier to maintain than legacy scripts.
Both options above are grammatically correct without the double comparative error.
complex.explanation: 'More easier' adalah kesalahan ganda (double comparative). Bentuk yang benar adalah cukup 'easier' saja, atau bila ingin diperkuat gunakan 'much easier'.

complex.prompt: Pola perbandingan proporsional ganda (parallel increase): 'The ___ we automate our testing, the ___ our delivery cycle becomes.'
complex.explanation: Struktur 'The + comparative..., the + comparative...' menyatakan hubungan proporsional sebab-akibat (semakin... semakin...): 'The more..., the faster...'.

complex.prompt: Perhatikan kata sifat serapan Latin yang berpasangan dengan 'to', bukan 'than': 'Her qualifications are superior ___ mine.'
complex.explanation: Comparative berakhiran -ior asal Latin (superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior) berpasangan dengan preposisi 'to', BUKAN 'than': 'superior to', 'prior to'.

complex.targetSentence: The harder you work the more you achieve.
complex.explanation: The + comparative (The harder you work) + the + comparative (the more you achieve).

complex.prompt: Koreksi perbandingan yang tidak setara (faulty / illogical comparison).
complex.draft: The battery life of this phone is longer than the competitor model.
options: The battery life of this phone is longer than that of the competitor model.
The battery life of this phone is longer than those of the competitor model.
The battery life of this phone is more long than the competitor model.
complex.explanation: Kesalahan 'illogical comparison': kalimat asli membandingkan 'battery life' (daya tahan baterai) dengan 'model HP fisik'. Untuk membandingkan dua hal yang setara, gunakan kata pengganti 'that of': 'longer than that of the competitor model'.
hints: Bandingkan daya tahan baterai dengan daya tahan baterai, bukan dengan HP-nya.
Gunakan pronoun 'that of' untuk menggantikan 'the battery life'.

complex.prompt: Between the two proposed marketing strategies, the board chose ___ one.
complex.explanation: Ketika membandingkan secara eksplisit HANYA ANTARA DUA hal ('Between the two...'), aturan tata bahasa baku mensyaratkan bentuk komparatif dengan article: 'the more cost-effective one' (bukan superlative 'most').
hints: Perbandingan eksklusif hanya antara dua benda (two items).

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dengan perbandingan bertingkat progresif.
dialogue: Economist
What trend are you observing in microchip manufacturing?
Industry Analyst
Automated production is becoming ___ specialized each year.
complex.explanation: Pola 'more and more + adjective' (atau comparative + and + comparative: 'faster and faster') menyatakan perubahan intensitas yang terus meningkat secara berkelanjutan.
hints: Menyatakan tren yang semakin lama semakin meningkat.

complex.prompt: This new polymer composite is far ___ to conventional fiberglass in salt-water corrosion resistance.
complex.explanation: Adjective serapan Latin ('superior', 'inferior', 'prior', 'senior', 'junior') TIDAK memakai 'more' atau '-er' dan berpasangan dengan preposisi 'to' (bukan 'than').
hints: 'Superior' sudah bermakna comparative sehingga tidak memakai 'more'.

complex.prompt: Legal scholars argue that the revised statute is no ___ ambiguous than the original 1998 text.
complex.explanation: Ungkapan 'no less [adj] than...' menyatakan bahwa kedua hal memiliki tingkat sifat tersebut secara penuh/setara ('sama-sama ambigu').

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan logika perbandingan inklusif/eksklusif pada kalimat laporan ekonomi berikut.
complex.draft: Singapore's port handles more cargo annually than any port in Southeast Asia.
options: Singapore's port handles more cargo annually than any other port in Southeast Asia.
Singapore's port handles more cargo annually than every port in Southeast Asia.
Singapore's port handles the more cargo annually than any other port in Southeast Asia.
complex.explanation: Karena pelabuhan Singapura sendiri bagian dari Asia Tenggara, kita wajib menambahkan 'other' ('than any other port') agar tidak membandingkan sesuatu dengan dirinya sendiri.
hints: Singapura berada di Asia Tenggara, jadi harus dikecualikan dengan 'other'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi riset akademik mengenai ketepatan modifier sebelum 'fewer' dan 'less'.
dialogue: Statistician
Should we write 'less than 200 respondents' or 'fewer than 200 respondents' in the paper?
Editor
Since 'respondents' is a plural countable noun, formal style strictly prefers ___.
complex.explanation: 'Respondents' adalah kata benda terhitung jamak, sehingga gaya tulis akademik resmi menggunakan 'fewer than' (bukan 'less than').

complex.prompt: As automated translation matures, cross-border customer support is becoming ___ seamless.
complex.explanation: Untuk adjective panjang pada ragam formal, penulisan ringkas 'becoming increasingly + adj' sering lebih elegan daripada pengulangan bertele-tele atau kombinasi salah.
hints: Cari bentuk modifikasi progresif yang benar secara gramatikal.

complex.prompt: Between the two candidate treatments tested in Phase II, the oral capsule proved ___ effective.
complex.explanation: Dalam penulisan akademik saat membandingkan persis dua item ('Between the two...'), bentuk 'the + comparative' ('the more effective') lebih presisi daripada superlative.
hints: Ada dua kandidat perlakuan yang dibandingkan.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan preposisi setelah adjective komparatif Latin 'prior' dan 'preferable'.
complex.draft: A face-to-face mediation is often more preferable than prolonged litigation.
options: A face-to-face mediation is often preferable to prolonged litigation.
A face-to-face mediation is often more preferable to prolonged litigation.
A face-to-face mediation is often preferable than prolonged litigation.
complex.explanation: 'Preferable' tidak memerlukan penguat 'more' dan berpasangan dengan preposisi 'to' ('preferable to'), bukan 'than'.
hints: Adjective 'preferable' sudah memuat makna perbandingan ('lebih disukai').

complex.prompt: No ___ had the quarterly earnings leaked than trading volume surged sharply.
complex.explanation: Konstruksi inversi waktu 'No sooner ... than ...' bermakna tepat segera setelah sesuatu terjadi.
hints: Lihat pasangan kata hubung 'than' setelah subjek.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat perbandingan setara paralel menggunakan pronoun 'those of'.
complex.targetSentence: The tuition fees at private colleges are higher than those of state universities.
complex.explanation: Karena membandingkan kata benda jamak 'tuition fees', gunakan pronoun pembanding jamak 'those of'.
hints: Awali dengan 'The tuition fees at private colleges are'.
Gunakan 'higher than those of' agar perbandingan sejajar.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai adjective Latin 'inferior to'.
complex.targetSentence: Cheap synthetic adhesives remain inferior to medical-grade bonding agents.
complex.explanation: Adjective komparatif Latin 'inferior' tidak memakai 'more' dan selalu memakai preposisi 'to'.
